mechanism: Clarithromycin may increase zoledronic acid exposure through CYP3A4 inhibition and potential effects on renal clearance, while both drugs carry independent risks of renal impairment and electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes (especially calcium and magnesium), and clinical response; ensure adequate hydration during concurrent use and consider alternative antibiotics if renal function is compromised.
